contributions.detail: DOUBLE GATE. All three itemized rows (200 + 1000 + 25) sum to 1225.00 = the Form A printed TOTAL. Separately, the OVER-$50 subset alone (200 + 1000) = 1200.00 = cover line 1 in BOTH the THIS and CUMULATIVE columns. The filer itemized his one $25 (sub-$50) gift on Form A anyway and folded it into the schedule total, so the schedule total here equals cover line1 + line2, not line 1; scoring the full row set against line 1 alone would have manufactured a false -25.00 mismatch. Reported against the schedule total, with line 1 reported as the independent over-$50 check. First report of the 2018 cycle (Totals-from-LAST-Report column blank throughout; certified period March 2018 - June 12, 2018), so THIS and CUMULATIVE coincide.
